calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.dragHint: Drag an appointment to move it.
calendar.legend: Colors show the treatment category; faded = completed, striped = awaiting payment.

newBooking.title: New booking
newBooking.intro: Book for an existing or new client, with any treatment or a custom service.
newBooking.searchClient: Search by name, email or phone

client.notePlaceholder: Preferences, allergies, anything the team should know.
client.privacyNote: Documents are private. Every access is recorded in the activity log.
client.anonymized: This client deleted their account. Personal details were removed.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.intro: Prices, durations and availability of every treatment. Changes apply to new bookings; existing bookings keep their price.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.depositBreakdown: Deposit {deposit} at booking · Total {total} · Rest {rest} after the treatment
catalog.depositOfOptions: {percent}% of the selected options, charged at booking
catalog.depositNone: Nothing is charged at booking: the full price is paid after the treatment
catalog.minOptionsHint: 0 = optional: the client can book the session without choosing any option
catalog.optionsRangeInvalid: The maximum can't be lower than the minimum
catalog.optionsFreeWarning: Options are optional and the base price is $0: a session with no option would be free
catalog.noOptions: No options yet. Clients book this treatment as is.
catalog.deleteOptionConfirm: Delete “{name}”? It disappears from the site and the booking form. Past bookings keep it.
catalog.duplicate: That URL name is already in use. Try a different name.

testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.intro: Client stories on the website. Choose the pages each story appears on; the order here is the order on the site.
testimonials.empty: No testimonials on this page yet.
testimonials.quoteHint: Short, without quotation marks: they are added on the site.
testimonials.imageAltHint: For screen readers and search engines, e.g. "Healed lip blush in a natural tone".
testimonials.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
testimonials.confirmDelete: Delete the testimonial "{quote}"? This cannot be undone.

team.title: Team & hours
team.hoursIntro: Business hours apply to everyone unless a specialist has their own.
team.blocksIntro: Holidays, days off and other time when nobody can book. Blocks created in the connected Google Calendar appear here too.
team.usersIntro: People who can sign in to the back office. Staff manage bookings and clients; admins also manage the catalog, team, settings and activity log.
team.findUser: Find a person by email to give access

settings.title: Settings
settings.minors: Minors can book with a guardian
settings.alertEmails: Staff alert emails (comma-separated; empty = all admins)
settings.reviewUrl: Google review link (empty = no review emails)
settings.reviewDelay: Ask for a review (hours after the visit)
settings.paymentsNote: Clients pay the deposit (or the full price) on Square’s secure checkout; the booking is confirmed when the payment arrives. While off, online bookings are confirmed immediately and paid at the studio.
settings.modeNote: Test mode uses Square’s sandbox: no real money moves (use Square’s test cards). Switch to live before taking real payments. Links already sent keep working in the mode they were made in.
settings.termsNote: These values are published in the Terms of service automatically.
settings.paymentsNotConfigured: The selected Square mode has no credentials on this server. Add SQUARE_SANDBOX_* (test) or SQUARE_PRODUCTION_* (live) in Vercel and redeploy.
settings.invalidPhone: Check the phone or WhatsApp number. Include the area code, e.g. (347) 483-3337 or +1 347 483 3337.
settings.depositNote: Charged online to reserve when a treatment has no fixed deposit in the catalog. 100 = full price. The client pays the rest after the treatment.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.intro: Every change in the system, who made it and when. Entries can never be edited or deleted.

payments.title: Payments
payments.awaiting: Waiting for the client to pay.
payments.refundIntro: Up to {amount} can be refunded. The refund goes back to the original card through Square.
payments.refundQueued: Refund sent to Square. It will show here in a moment.
payments.linkFor: {amount} · {kind, select, deposit {deposit} balance {balance} other {payment}} · the client only sees it if you send it
payments.linkIntro: Creates a Square checkout link you can send by WhatsApp, text or email. The amount defaults to what is owed now; change it if the final price was adjusted. Any previous unpaid link stops working.
payments.linkCreated: Link created and copied to the clipboard.
